message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to search for hotels that specifically offer vegetarian meals or spa services. The function I can use only lets me look up hotels in a given location that have one of the following amenities: “Breakfast”, “Fitness Centre”, “Free Wi‑Fi”, or “Parking”. 

If you’d like, I can search for hotels in New York that have any of those amenities. Let me know which ones (or all of them) you’re interested in, and I’ll do a quick lookup.
